title: Breath effects: burn and corrode
note: Design doc §3: Fire sets a lane burning along its line through Close and Far, as wide as the blast; Earth leaves a corrosive pool. Zones hit grounded dragons standing in them at slot's end and linger Potency ÷ 6 slots (more for a charged Breath); a burn deals Potency ÷ 4. A True Dragon's own fire never harms it. A corroded dragon's Hardness drops by 3 for a slot. (Water's push and Air's pull are in push-and-shove.json.)
